Subject: CTO wants 30m on Wed 25 Jul at 14:30 — need compact agenda + coverage

Morning —

Received confirmation: EdgeScale's CTO locked a 30-minute window Wed 25 Jul, 14:30–15:00 ET. Sam asked for a tightly focused business-outcomes brief and a short mutual action plan for procurement. Two asks:

1) Can Marissa join as the executive sponsor for the first 20 minutes to cover outcomes and ROI? If not, who can represent the exec angle?
2) Karthik — can you be on standby to take the deeper tech break-out at 15:00 if they want to continue? If CTO leaves after 30m, we should have a plan to capture technical follow-ups asynchronously.

Suggested compact agenda (30m):
- 14:30–14:35: Quick intros + goal-setting (Sam + CTO)
- 14:35–14:50: Executive-focused outcome brief (Marissa or exec)
- 14:50–15:00: Quick Q&A and next-step commitments (procurement ask + MAD)

I will prepare a one-slide MAD (mutual action plan) and a price-range summary. Please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CTO wants 30m on Wed 25 Jul at 14:30 — need compact agenda + coverage

Rishi — I can cover the exec brief for 12–15 minutes. I'll focus on customer outcomes (latency, cost delta, SLA options) and a high-level rollout plan. Karthik — please be ready to jump in for a 30–45 minute technical breakout at 15:00; if CTO stays we can extend, otherwise we run the breakout with Sam + engineers.

Two quick notes:
- Compress the MAD to 3 milestones (POC, pilot, production) with rough timelines and a vendor responsibilities column.
- Include a single slide that maps performance (latency/cost) tradeoffs for hosted vs. dedicated vs. private — CTOs like crisp decision points.

I can join the call from 14:25 to ensure a smooth handoff.

Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
